title: Local business leads
description: Enter an industry keyword and a city. Returns business name, website, phone, address, and email when found on OSM tags or the business website.

query.title: Industry / keyword
query.description: What to look for, e.g. plumber, dentist, cafe, lawyer.

location.title: City / location
location.description: City or 'City, Country' / 'City, ST', e.g. Austin, TX or Berlin, Germany.

maxItems.title: Max leads
maxItems.description: Maximum number of leads to return (1–500).

enrichEmail.title: Enrich email from website
enrichEmail.description: If true, visit each business website/contact page and look for mailto or obvious emails. Slower but higher email rate.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only leads with email
onlyWithEmail.description: If true, only return rows that have a non-empty email. Rows without email are dropped and not charged (no lead-basic for filtered rows). Fetches extra candidates so maxItems still means up to that many email leads.
